### Devotional: Psalms 7–8
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/leviticus-7-psalms-7-8-proverbs-22-1-thess-1/
Passage: Psalm 7:14-17
Points:
- David turns to divine justice after facing the pain of betrayal and false accusation.
- The schemes of the wicked ultimately recoil on their own heads, trapping the digger in his own pit.
- Hope for justice rests neither on impersonal karma nor wishful optimism, but on God's righteous character.
- Even when evil people cause terrible harm in this life, final justice will be settled at the last judgment.
- Trusting that God will establish righteousness leads to thankful praise to the Most High.
